private lemma no_mono {c : ℕ → Bool}
    (H : ∀ x d, 0 < x → x < d → c x = c (x + d) → c (x + d) ≠ c (x + 2 * d))

name: key
statement: key (c : ℕ → Bool) (H : ∀ x d, 0 < x → x < d → c x = c (x + d) → c (x + d) ≠ c (x + 2 * d)) (hc1 : c 1 = true) : False
code:
private lemma key (c : ℕ → Bool)
    (H : ∀ x d, 0 < x → x < d → c x = c (x + d) → c (x + d) ≠ c (x + 2 * d))
    (hc1 : c 1 = true) : False := by
  have blue_odd : ∀ n, 3 ≤ n → c n = true → c (2 * n - 1) = false := by
    intro n hn hcn
    have h := no_mono H 1 (n - 1) n (2 * n - 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
    cases h' : c (2 * n - 1) with
    | false => rfl
    | true => exact (h ⟨hc1.trans hcn.symm, hcn.trans h'.symm⟩).elim
  have h0 := no_mono H 1 2 3 5 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
  cases h3 : c 3 with
  | false =>
    have stepA : ∀ n, 6 ≤ n → c n = true → c (n + 1) = true := by
      intro n hn hcn
      have hb := blue_odd n (by omega) hcn
      have h := no_mono H 3 (n - 2) (n + 1) (2 * n - 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      cases h' : c (n + 1) with
      | true => rfl
      | false => exact (h ⟨h3.trans h'.symm, h'.trans hb.symm⟩).elim
    by_cases hex : ∃ n₀, 6 ≤ n₀ ∧ c n₀ = true
    · obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀, hcn₀⟩ := hex
      have hall : ∀ j, c (n₀ + j) = true := by
        intro j
        induction j with
        | zero => exact hcn₀
        | succ j ih =>
          rw [← Nat.add_assoc]
          exact stepA (n₀ + j) (by omega) ih
      exact H n₀ (n₀ + 1) (by omega) (by omega) (hcn₀.trans (hall (n₀ + 1)).symm)
        ((hall (n₀ + 1)).trans (hall (2 * (n₀ + 1))).symm)
    · have hf : ∀ n, 6 ≤ n → c n = false := by
        intro n hn
        cases h : c n with
        | false => rfl
        | true => exact (hex ⟨n, hn, h⟩).elim
      have h := no_mono H 6 7 13 20 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      exact h ⟨(hf 6 (by omega)).trans (hf 13 (by omega)).symm,
        (hf 13 (by omega)).trans (hf 20 (by omega)).symm⟩
  | true =>
    cases h5 : c 5 with
    | true => exact (h0 ⟨hc1.trans h3.symm, h3.trans h5.symm⟩).elim
    | false =>
      have stepB : ∀ n, 9 ≤ n → c n = true → c (n + 2) = true := by
        intro n hn hcn
        have hb := blue_odd n (by omega) hcn
        have h := no_mono H 5 (n - 3) (n + 2) (2 * n - 1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
        cases h' : c (n + 2) with
        | true => rfl
        | false => exact (h ⟨h5.trans h'.symm, h'.trans hb.symm⟩).elim
      by_cases hex : ∃ n₀, 9 ≤ n₀ ∧ c n₀ = true
      · obtain ⟨n₀, hn₀, hcn₀⟩ := hex
        have hall : ∀ j, c (n₀ + 2 * j) = true := by
          intro j
          induction j with
          | zero => simpa using hcn₀
          | succ j ih =>
            rw [show n₀ + 2 * (j + 1) = n₀ + 2 * j + 2 by omega]
            exact stepB (n₀ + 2 * j) (by omega) ih
        exact H n₀ (2 * n₀) (by omega) (by omega) (hcn₀.trans (hall n₀).symm)
          ((hall n₀).trans (hall (2 * n₀)).symm)
      · have hf : ∀ n, 9 ≤ n → c n = false := by
          intro n hn
          cases h : c n with
          | false => rfl
          | true => exact (hex ⟨n, hn, h⟩).elim
        have h := no_mono H 9 10 19 29 (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
        exact h ⟨(hf 9 (by omega)).trans (hf 19 (by omega)).symm,
          (hf 19 (by omega)).trans (hf 29 (by omega)).symm⟩

name: erdos_316_int
statement: erdos_316_int (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, n ∣ 120) : ∃ k : ℕ, 120 * ∑ n ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / n = k
code:
private lemma erdos_316_int (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ n ∈ S, n ∣ 120) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, 120 * ∑ n ∈ S, (1 : ℚ) / n = k := by
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => exact ⟨0, by simp⟩
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih fun n hn => hS n (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hn)
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hS a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
    have ha0 : (a : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
      have : a ≠ 0 := by
        rintro rfl
        omega
      exact_mod_cast this
    have hm' : (120 : ℚ) = a * m := by exact_mod_cast hm
    refine ⟨m + k, ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, mul_add, hk]
    push_cast
    linear_combination (1 / (a : ℚ)) * hm' + (m : ℚ) * mul_one_div_cancel ha0

name: erdos_397_key
statement: erdos_397_key (a : ℕ) : Nat.centralBinom a * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1)) = Nat.centralBinom (a + 1) * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) * Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1))
code:
private lemma erdos_397_key (a : ℕ) :
    Nat.centralBinom a * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1 + 1) *
        Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1)) =
      Nat.centralBinom (a + 1) * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) *
        Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1)) := by
  have h1 := Nat.succ_mul_centralBinom_succ a
  have h2 := Nat.succ_mul_centralBinom_succ (2 * a)
  have h3 := Nat.succ_mul_centralBinom_succ (2 * a + 1)
  have h4 := Nat.succ_mul_centralBinom_succ (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1)
  have hK : 0 < (a + 1) * (2 * a + 1) * (2 * a + 1 + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) := by
    positivity
  apply Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left hK
  calc (a + 1) * (2 * a + 1) * (2 * a + 1 + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) *
        (Nat.centralBinom a * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1 + 1) *
          Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1)))
      = (a + 1) * (2 * a + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom a *
          Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1) *
          ((2 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1 + 1)) := by ring
    _ = (a + 1) * (2 * a + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom a *
          Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1) *
          (2 * (2 * (2 * a + 1) + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1)) := by rw [h3]
    _ = (a + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom a *
          Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1) * (2 * (2 * (2 * a + 1) + 1)) *
          ((2 * a + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1)) := by ring
    _ = (a + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom a *
          Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1) * (2 * (2 * (2 * a + 1) + 1)) *
          (2 * (2 * (2 * a) + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (2 * a)) := by rw [h2]
    _ = (2 * a + 1) * (2 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) *
          (2 * (2 * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1) + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1)) *
          (2 * (2 * a + 1) * Nat.centralBinom a) := by ring
    _ = (2 * a + 1) * (2 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) *
          ((8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1)) *
          ((a + 1) * Nat.centralBinom (a + 1)) := by rw [← h4, ← h1]
    _ = (a + 1) * (2 * a + 1) * (2 * a + 1 + 1) * (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1) *
        (Nat.centralBinom (a + 1) * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) *
          Nat.centralBinom (8 * a ^ 2 + 8 * a + 1 + 1))) := by ring

name: erdos_397_mem
statement: erdos_397_mem (a c : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hc : 2 * a + 1 + 1 < c) (hprod : Nat.centralBinom a * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom c) = Nat.centralBinom (a + 1) * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) * Nat.centralBinom (c + 1))) : (({a, 2 * a + 1 + 1, c} : Finset ℕ), ({a + 1, 2 * a, c + 1} : Finset ℕ)) ∈ {p : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ | Disjoint p.1 p.2 ∧ p.1.Nonempty ∧ p.2.Nonempty ∧ (∀ m ∈ p.1, 0 < m) ∧ (∀ n ∈ p.2, 0 < n) ∧ ∏ m ∈ p.1, Nat.centralBinom m = ∏ n ∈ p.2, Nat.centralBinom n}
code:
private lemma erdos_397_mem (a c : ℕ) (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hc : 2 * a + 1 + 1 < c)
    (hprod : Nat.centralBinom a * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a + 1 + 1) * Nat.centralBinom c) =
      Nat.centralBinom (a + 1) * (Nat.centralBinom (2 * a) * Nat.centralBinom (c + 1))) :
    (({a, 2 * a + 1 + 1, c} : Finset ℕ), ({a + 1, 2 * a, c + 1} : Finset ℕ)) ∈
      {p : Finset ℕ × Finset ℕ |
        Disjoint p.1 p.2 ∧ p.1.Nonempty ∧ p.2.Nonempty ∧
        (∀ m ∈ p.1, 0 < m) ∧ (∀ n ∈ p.2, 0 < n) ∧
        ∏ m ∈ p.1, Nat.centralBinom m = ∏ n ∈ p.2, Nat.centralBinom n} := by
  have hn1 : a ∉ ({2 * a + 1 + 1, c} : Finset ℕ) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
  have hn2 : 2 * a + 1 + 1 ∉ ({c} : Finset ℕ) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
  have hn3 : a + 1 ∉ ({2 * a, c + 1} : Finset ℕ) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
  have hn4 : 2 * a ∉ ({c + 1} : Finset ℕ) := by
    simp only [Finset.mem_singleton]; omega
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ⟨a, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩, ⟨a + 1, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx'
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hx hx'
    omega
  · intro m hm
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hm
    omega
  · intro n hn
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hn
    omega
  · rw [Finset.prod_insert hn1, Finset.prod_insert hn2, Finset.prod_singleton,
      Finset.prod_insert hn3, Finset.prod_insert hn4, Finset.prod_singleton]
    exact hprod

private lemma erdos_674_key (x y z : ℕ) (h1 : 12 * x + 8 * y = 11 * z)
    (h2 : 6 * x + 8 * y = 7 * z) :

  have hx : (2 ^ 12 * 3 ^ 6 : ℕ) ^ x = 2 ^ (12 * x) * 3 ^ (6 * x) := by

    rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
  have hz : (2 ^ 11 * 3 ^ 7 : ℕ) ^ z = 2 ^ (11 * z) * 3 ^ (7 * z) := by
    rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul]
  rw [hx, hy, hz, mul_mul_mul_comm, ← pow_add, ← pow_add, h1, h2]

name: isSquare_of_even_factorization
statement: isSquare_of_even_factorization (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) (h : ∀ p, Even (n.factorization p)) : IsSquare n
code:
private lemma isSquare_of_even_factorization (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ p, Even (n.factorization p)) : IsSquare n := by
  refine ⟨n.factorization.prod (fun p k => p ^ (k / 2)), ?_⟩
  conv_lhs => rw [← Nat.prod_factorization_pow_eq_self hn]
  rw [← Finsupp.prod_mul]
  apply Finsupp.prod_congr
  intro p _
  show p ^ n.factorization p = p ^ (n.factorization p / 2) * p ^ (n.factorization p / 2)
  rw [← pow_add]
  congr 1
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h p
  omega

name: even_symmdiff
statement: even_symmdiff {S T : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, 1 ≤ x) (p : ℕ) (hpar : Odd ((∏ x ∈ S, blk x).factorization p) ↔ Odd ((∏ x ∈ T, blk x).factorization p)) : Even ((∏ x ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), blk x).factorization p)
code:
private lemma even_symmdiff {S T : Finset ℕ} (hS : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ x) (hT : ∀ x ∈ T, 1 ≤ x)
    (p : ℕ)
    (hpar : Odd ((∏ x ∈ S, blk x).factorization p) ↔ Odd ((∏ x ∈ T, blk x).factorization p)) :
    Even ((∏ x ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), blk x).factorization p) := by
  have h1 : ∏ x ∈ S, blk x = (∏ x ∈ S \ T, blk x) * ∏ x ∈ S ∩ T, blk x := by
    rw [← Finset.sdiff_inter_self_left S T, Finset.prod_sdiff Finset.inter_subset_left]
  have h2 : ∏ x ∈ T, blk x = (∏ x ∈ T \ S, blk x) * ∏ x ∈ S ∩ T, blk x := by
    rw [← Finset.sdiff_inter_self_right T S, Finset.prod_sdiff Finset.inter_subset_right]
  have h3 : ∏ x ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), blk x = (∏ x ∈ S \ T, blk x) * ∏ x ∈ T \ S, blk x :=
    Finset.prod_union disjoint_sdiff_sdiff
  have nST : ∏ x ∈ S \ T, blk x ≠ 0 :=
    prod_blk_ne_zero fun x hx => hS x (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).1
  have nTS : ∏ x ∈ T \ S, blk x ≠ 0 :=
    prod_blk_ne_zero fun x hx => hT x (Finset.mem_sdiff.mp hx).1
  have nI : ∏ x ∈ S ∩ T, blk x ≠ 0 :=
    prod_blk_ne_zero fun x hx => hS x (Finset.mem_inter.mp hx).1
  rw [h1, Nat.factorization_mul nST nI, h2, Nat.factorization_mul nTS nI] at hpar
  rw [h3, Nat.factorization_mul nST nTS]
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply, Nat.odd_iff, Nat.even_iff] at hpar ⊢
  omega

name: exists_square_collection
statement: exists_square_collection (n : ℕ) : ∃ U : Finset ℕ, U.Nonempty ∧ (∀ x ∈ U, n < x ∧ x % 4 = 1) ∧ IsSquare (∏ x ∈ U, blk x)
code:
private lemma exists_square_collection (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ U : Finset ℕ, U.Nonempty ∧ (∀ x ∈ U, n < x ∧ x % 4 = 1) ∧
      IsSquare (∏ x ∈ U, blk x) := by
  set m := 3 * n + 5000 with hm
  set a := n / 4 + 1 with ha
  set X : Finset ℕ := (Finset.Ico a m).image (fun k => 4 * k + 1) with hX
  have hXmem : ∀ x ∈ X, n < x ∧ x % 4 = 1 ∧ x ≤ 4 * m := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hX, Finset.mem_image] at hx
    obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    omega
  have hXcard : X.card = m - a := by
    rw [hX, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (fun k l h => by simpa using h), Nat.card_Ico]
  set Pr : Finset ℕ := (Finset.range (4 * m + 4)).filter Nat.Prime with hPr
  have hPrcard : Pr.card = Nat.primeCounting' (4 * m + 4) := by
    rw [hPr, Nat.primeCounting', Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
  have hpi : Nat.primeCounting' (4 * m + 4) < m - a := by
    have h1 := Nat.primeCounting'_add_le (a := 210) (k := 211) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (4 * m + 4 - 211)
    have h2 : 211 + (4 * m + 4 - 211) = 4 * m + 4 := by omega
    rw [h2] at h1
    have h3 : Nat.primeCounting' 211 ≤ 211 := by
      rw [Nat.primeCounting', Nat.count_eq_card_filter_range]
      exact (Finset.card_filter_le _ _).trans (Finset.card_range 211).le
    have h4 : Nat.totient 210 = 48 := by decide +kernel
    rw [h4] at h1
    omega
  have hlt : Pr.powerset.card < X.powerset.card := by
    rw [Finset.card_powerset, Finset.card_powerset, hXcard, hPrcard]
    exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) hpi
  set v : Finset ℕ → Finset ℕ :=
    fun S => Pr.filter (fun p => Odd ((∏ x ∈ S, blk x).factorization p)) with hv
  obtain ⟨S, hS, T, hT, hne, hvST⟩ := Finset.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt_of_maps_to hlt
    (f := v) (fun S _ => Finset.mem_powerset.mpr (Finset.filter_subset _ _))
  rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hS hT
  have hS1 : ∀ x ∈ S, 1 ≤ x := fun x hx => by have := hXmem x (hS hx); omega
  have hT1 : ∀ x ∈ T, 1 ≤ x := fun x hx => by have := hXmem x (hT hx); omega
  have hUX : ∀ x ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), x ∈ X := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_sdiff] at hx
    rcases hx with h | h
    · exact hS h.1
    · exact hT h.1
  refine ⟨(S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty]
    intro h
    rw [Finset.union_eq_empty, Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset,
      Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset] at h
    exact hne (Finset.Subset.antisymm h.1 h.2)
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨(hXmem x (hUX x hx)).1, (hXmem x (hUX x hx)).2.1⟩
  · have hU1 : ∀ x ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), 1 ≤ x := fun x hx => by
      have := hXmem x (hUX x hx); omega
    have hUB : ∀ x ∈ (S \ T) ∪ (T \ S), x ≤ 4 * m := fun x hx => (hXmem x (hUX x hx)).2.2
    apply isSquare_of_even_factorization _ (prod_blk_ne_zero hU1)
    intro p
    by_cases hp : p.Prime
    · by_cases hpm : p < 4 * m + 4
      · apply even_symmdiff hS1 hT1
        have hpPr : p ∈ Pr := by
          rw [hPr, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]
          exact ⟨hpm, hp⟩
        have := congrArg (fun A => p ∈ A) hvST

code:
private lemma erdos_370_mem (k : ℕ) :
    (k + 3) ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7) ∈
      {n : ℕ | 2 ≤ n ∧ (∀ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ^ 2 < n) ∧
        (∀ p ∈ (n + 1).primeFactors, p ^ 2 < n + 1)} := by
  have hexp : (k + 3) ^ 2 = k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 9 := by ring
  have h9 : 9 ≤ (k + 3) ^ 2 := by rw [hexp]; omega
  have h7 : 7 ≤ k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7 := by omega
  have hsq : (k + 3) ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7) + 1 = ((k + 2) * (k + 4)) ^ 2 := by ring
  have hbig : (k + 3) ^ 2 * 7 ≤ (k + 3) ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7) :=
    Nat.mul_le_mul_left ((k + 3) ^ 2) h7
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · omega
  · intro p hp
    rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hp
    obtain ⟨hp, hdvd, -⟩ := hp
    rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp hdvd with h | h
    · have h2 : p ≤ k + 3 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) (hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow h)
      have h3 : p ^ 2 ≤ (k + 3) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h2 2
      omega
    · have h2 : p ≤ k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7 := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h
      have h3 : p ^ 2 ≤ (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h2 2
      have h4 : (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7) ^ 2 < (k + 3) ^ 2 * (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7) := by
        rw [pow_two (k ^ 2 + 6 * k + 7)]
        apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega)
        rw [hexp]; omega
      omega
  · intro p hp
    rw [hsq] at hp ⊢
    rw [Nat.mem_primeFactors] at hp
    obtain ⟨hp, hdvd, -⟩ := hp
    have h1 : p ∣ (k + 2) * (k + 4) := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hdvd
    have h2 : p ≤ k + 4 := by
      rcases (Nat.Prime.dvd_mul hp).mp h1 with h | h
      · have := Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h
        omega
      · exact Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) h
    have h3 : k + 4 < (k + 2) * (k + 4) := by
      have : (k + 2) * (k + 4) = k * (k + 4) + 2 * (k + 4) := by ring
      rw [this]; omega
    have h4 : p ^ 2 ≤ (k + 4) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left h2 2
    have h5 : (k + 4) ^ 2 < ((k + 2) * (k + 4)) ^ 2 := Nat.pow_lt_pow_left h3 (by norm_num)
    omega

theorem erdos_172_sub2_4 (r : ℕ) (c : ℕ → Fin r) (k : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (hpos : ∀ n, 0 < f n) (i : Fin r)
    (h : ∀ B ⊆ Finset.range k, B.Nonempty →
      c (∑ j ∈ B, f j) = i ∧ c (∏ j ∈ B, f j) = i) :
    ∃ A : Finset ℕ, k ≤ A.card ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, 0 < a) ∧
      ∃ i : Fin r, ∀ B ⊆ A, B.Nonempty →
        c (∑ x ∈ B, x) = i ∧ c (∏ x ∈ B, x) = i := by
  refine ⟨(Finset.range k).image f, ?_, ?_, i, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hf, Finset.card_range]
  · intro a ha
    rw [Finset.mem_image] at ha
    obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := ha

  · intro B hB hBne

        obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := hxA
        rw [Finset.mem_image]
        refine ⟨j, ?_, rfl⟩
        rw [hB', Finset.mem_filter]
        exact ⟨hj, hx⟩
    have hB'ne : B'.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hBne
      rw [← himg, Finset.mem_image] at hx
      obtain ⟨j, hj, _⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨j, hj⟩
    obtain ⟨hs, hp⟩ := h B' hB'sub hB'ne
    rw [← himg, Finset.sum_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => hf hxy),
      Finset.prod_image (fun x _ y _ hxy => hf hxy)]

name: geometric_zero
statement: geometric_zero (f : ℤ → ℂ) (b : ℂ) (hb : b ≠ 0) (h0 : f 0 = 0) (hs : ∀ x, f (x + 1) = b * f x) : ∀ x, f x = 0
code:
private lemma geometric_zero (f : ℤ → ℂ) (b : ℂ) (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (h0 : f 0 = 0) (hs : ∀ x, f (x + 1) = b * f x) : ∀ x, f x = 0 := by
  intro x
  induction x using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => exact h0
  | succ k ih => simpa [ih] using hs (k : ℤ)
  | pred k ih =>
    have h := hs (-(k : ℤ) - 1)
    have he : -(k : ℤ) - 1 + 1 = -(k : ℤ) := by ring
    rw [he, ih] at h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left hb

name: sum_geometric_zero
statement: sum_geometric_zero {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (b : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → ℤ → ℂ) (hb : ∀ i ∈ S, b i ≠ 0) (hf : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ x, f i (x + 1) = b i * f i x) (h0 : ∀ k : ℕ, k < S.card → ∑ i ∈ S, f i k = 0) : ∀ x : ℤ, ∑ i ∈ S, f i x = 0
code:
private lemma sum_geometric_zero {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι)
    (b : ι → ℂ) (f : ι → ℤ → ℂ) (hb : ∀ i ∈ S, b i ≠ 0)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ S, ∀ x, f i (x + 1) = b i * f i x)
    (h0 : ∀ k : ℕ, k < S.card → ∑ i ∈ S, f i k = 0) :
    ∀ x : ℤ, ∑ i ∈ S, f i x = 0 := by
  classical
  induction S using Finset.induction_on generalizing f with
  | empty => simp
  | @insert j S hj ih =>
    have hdiff : ∀ x : ℤ, ∑ i ∈ S, (b i - b j) * f i x = 0 := by
      apply ih (fun i x => (b i - b j) * f i x)
      · exact fun i hi => hb i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
      · intro i hi x
        rw [hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) x]
        ring
      · intro k hk
        have h1 := h0 k (by simp only [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hj]; omega)
        have h2 := h0 (k + 1) (by simp only [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hj]; omega)
        simp only [Finset.sum_insert hj, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] at h1 h2
        simp only [hf j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)] at h2
        calc
          ∑ i ∈ S, (b i - b j) * f i k =
              (∑ i ∈ S, f i ((k : ℤ) + 1)) - b j * ∑ i ∈ S, f i k := by
                simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
                congr 1
                apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
                intro i hi
                exact (hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) k).symm
          _ = 0 := by linear_combination h2 - b j * h1
    apply geometric_zero (fun x => ∑ i ∈ insert j S, f i x) (b j)
      (hb j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _))
    · exact h0 0 (by simp)
    · intro x
      simp only [Finset.sum_insert hj, hf j (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)]
      have h := hdiff x
      simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum] at h
      have he : ∑ i ∈ S, f i (x + 1) = ∑ i ∈ S, b i * f i x :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi) x)
      rw [he]
      linear_combination h

name: power_of_two649
statement: power_of_two649 (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → r = 2) : ∃ k : ℕ, n = 2 ^ k

private lemma power_of_two649 (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (h : ∀ r : ℕ, Nat.Prime r → r ∣ n → r = 2) :
    ∃ k : ℕ, n = 2 ^ k := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hn1 : n = 1
    · exact ⟨0, by simpa using hn1⟩
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hpn⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hn1
    have hp2 := h p hp hpn
    subst p
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hpn
    have hmpos : 0 < m := by omega
    have hmlt : m < n := by omega
    have hmn : m ∣ n := ⟨2, by omega⟩
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih m hmlt hmpos (fun r hr hrd => h r hr (dvd_trans hrd hmn))
    refine ⟨k + 1, ?_⟩
    rw [hm, hk, pow_succ]
    omega

private lemma erdos_499_prod_rpow {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x)

  revert hf
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro _; simp
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
    intro hf

    have h2 : ∀ k ∈ s, 0 ≤ f k := fun k hk => hf k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hk)

      Real.rpow_add_of_nonneg hx h1 (Finset.sum_nonneg h2)]

name: erdos_499_row
statement: erdos_499_row (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j) (hs : ∑ j, v j = 1) : (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ j, v j ^ v j
code:
private lemma erdos_499_row (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℝ) (hv : ∀ j, 0 ≤ v j)
    (hs : ∑ j, v j = 1) :
    (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ j, v j ^ v j := by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) < n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
    · subst h; simp at hs
    · exact_mod_cast h
  have hgm := Real.geom_mean_le_arith_mean_weighted Finset.univ v (fun j => (v j)⁻¹)
    (fun j _ => hv j) hs (fun j _ => inv_nonneg.mpr (hv j))
  have hle : ∑ j, v j * (v j)⁻¹ ≤ (n : ℝ) := by
    calc ∑ j, v j * (v j)⁻¹ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin n, (1 : ℝ) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro j _
          by_cases h : v j = 0
          · simp [h]
          · exact (mul_inv_cancel₀ h).le
      _ = n := by simp
  have hprod : ∏ j, (v j)⁻¹ ^ v j = (∏ j, v j ^ v j)⁻¹ := by
    rw [← Finset.prod_inv_distrib]
    exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => Real.inv_rpow (hv j) (v j)
  have hQpos : 0 < ∏ j, v j ^ v j := by
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro j _
    rcases (hv j).eq_or_lt with h | h
    · rw [← h]; simp
    · exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos h _
  have hQinv : (∏ j, v j ^ v j)⁻¹ ≤ n := by
    rw [← hprod]; exact hgm.trans hle
  have h1 : (∏ j, v j ^ v j)⁻¹ * ∏ j, v j ^ v j = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hQpos.ne'
  have h2 : (∏ j, v j ^ v j)⁻¹ * ∏ j, v j ^ v j ≤ n * ∏ j, v j ^ v j :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hQinv hQpos.le
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hn, mul_comm]
  linarith

name: erdos_499_core
statement: erdos_499_core {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ) (h0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, a i j = 1) (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hw1 : ∑ k, w k = 1) (τ : ι → Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (hdec : ∀ i j, a i j = ∑ k, w k * (if τ k i = j then 1 else 0)) : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (n : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) ≤ ∏ i, a i (σ i)
code:
private lemma erdos_499_core {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → Fin n → ℝ)
    (h0 : ∀ i j, 0 ≤ a i j) (hrow : ∀ i, ∑ j, a i j = 1)
    (w : ι → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) (hw1 : ∑ k, w k = 1) (τ : ι → Equiv.Perm (Fin n))
    (hdec : ∀ i j, a i j = ∑ k, w k * (if τ k i = j then 1 else 0)) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), (n : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) ≤ ∏ i, a i (σ i) := by
  obtain ⟨σ, -, hmax⟩ := Finset.exists_max_image Finset.univ
    (fun σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) => ∏ i, a i (σ i)) Finset.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  have hM : 0 ≤ ∏ i, a i (σ i) := Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => h0 i _
  have hA : ∏ k, (∏ i, a i (τ k i)) ^ w k ≤ ∏ i, a i (σ i) := by
    calc ∏ k, (∏ i, a i (τ k i)) ^ w k ≤ ∏ k, (∏ i, a i (σ i)) ^ w k := by
          apply Finset.prod_le_prod
          · intro k _
            exact Real.rpow_nonneg (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => h0 i _) _
          · intro k _
            exact Real.rpow_le_rpow (Finset.prod_nonneg fun i _ => h0 i _)
              (hmax (τ k) (Finset.mem_univ _)) (hw k)
      _ = (∏ i, a i (σ i)) ^ (∑ k, w k) :=
          erdos_499_prod_rpow Finset.univ (∏ i, a i (σ i)) hM w (fun k _ => hw k)
      _ = ∏ i, a i (σ i) := by rw [hw1, Real.rpow_one]
  have hB : ∏ k, (∏ i, a i (τ k i)) ^ w k = ∏ i, ∏ j, a i j ^ a i j := by
    calc ∏ k, (∏ i, a i (τ k i)) ^ w k = ∏ k, ∏ i, a i (τ k i) ^ w k := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
          exact erdos_499_rpow_prod Finset.univ (fun i => a i (τ k i)) (fun i _ => h0 i _) (w k)
      _ = ∏ i, ∏ k, a i (τ k i) ^ w k := Finset.prod_comm
      _ = ∏ i, ∏ k, ∏ j, a i j ^ (w k * if τ k i = j then 1 else 0) := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.prod_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
          rw [Finset.prod_eq_single (τ k i)]
          · simp
          · intro j _ hj
            simp [hj, Ne.symm hj]
          · intro h
            exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
      _ = ∏ i, ∏ j, ∏ k, a i j ^ (w k * if τ k i = j then 1 else 0) := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.prod_comm
      _ = ∏ i, ∏ j, a i j ^ a i j := by
          refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun i _ => Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
          have hnn : ∀ k, 0 ≤ w k * (if τ k i = j then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := fun k =>
            mul_nonneg (hw k) (by split_ifs <;> norm_num)
          rw [erdos_499_prod_rpow Finset.univ (a i j) (h0 i j)
            (fun k => w k * if τ k i = j then 1 else 0) (fun k _ => hnn k)]
          congr 1
          exact (hdec i j).symm
  have hC : ∏ _i : Fin n, (1 / (n : ℝ)) ≤ ∏ i, ∏ j, a i j ^ a i j := by
    apply Finset.prod_le_prod
    · intro i _; positivity
    · intro i _; exact erdos_499_row n (a i) (h0 i) (hrow i)
  have hpow : (n : ℝ) ^ (-(n : ℤ)) = ∏ _i : Fin n, (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
    rw [Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, zpow_neg, zpow_natCast,
      one_div, inv_pow]
  rw [hpow]
  rw [hB] at hA
  exact hC.trans hA

  classical
  have hd : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - x := by linarith
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := Finset.exists_nat_subset_range
    (A.powerset.image (fun S : Finset ℕ => ∑ n ∈ S, n))
  have hinj : ∀ S ∈ A.powerset, ∀ T ∈ A.powerset, (∑ n ∈ S, n) = (∑ n ∈ T, n) → S = T :=
    fun S hS T hT h => hdis S (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hS) T (Finset.mem_powerset.mp hT) h
  have himg : ∑ m ∈ A.powerset.image (fun S : Finset ℕ => ∑ n ∈ S, n), x ^ m
      = ∑ t ∈ A.powerset, x ^ (∑ n ∈ t, n) := Finset.sum_image hinj
  have hexp := Finset.prod_add (fun n : ℕ => x ^ n) (fun _ : ℕ => (1 : ℝ)) A
  simp only [Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one] at hexp
  have hgeom : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ m) ≤ (1 - x)⁻¹ := by
    have h1 : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ m) * (1 - x) ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [geom_sum_mul x M, pow_nonneg hx0 M]
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hd))
    rwa [mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hd), mul_one, one_mul] at h2
  calc ∏ n ∈ A, (1 + x ^ n) = ∏ n ∈ A, (x ^ n + 1) :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun n _ => add_comm _ _)
    _ = ∑ t ∈ A.powerset, ∏ i ∈ t, x ^ i := hexp
    _ = ∑ t ∈ A.powerset, x ^ (∑ n ∈ t, n) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun t _ => erdos_350_prod_pow x t)
    _ = ∑ m ∈ A.powerset.image (fun S : Finset ℕ => ∑ n ∈ S, n), x ^ m := himg.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, x ^ m :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hM (fun m _ _ => pow_nonneg hx0 m)
    _ ≤ (1 - x)⁻¹ := hgeom

name: erdos_350_log_le
statement: erdos_350_log_le (A : Finset ℕ) (hdis : ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ A, ∑ n ∈ S, n = ∑ n ∈ T, n → S = T) {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) : ∑ n ∈ A, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) ≤ -Real.log (1 - x)
code:
private lemma erdos_350_log_le (A : Finset ℕ)
    (hdis : ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ A, ∑ n ∈ S, n = ∑ n ∈ T, n → S = T)
    {x : ℝ} (hx0 : 0 < x) (hx1 : x < 1) :
    ∑ n ∈ A, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) ≤ -Real.log (1 - x) := by
  have hpos : ∀ n ∈ A, (0 : ℝ) < 1 + x ^ n := by
    intro n _
    have h := pow_nonneg hx0.le n
    linarith
  have hprodpos : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ n ∈ A, (1 + x ^ n) := Finset.prod_pos hpos
  have h1 : Real.log (∏ n ∈ A, (1 + x ^ n)) = ∑ n ∈ A, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) := by
    apply Real.log_prod
    intro n hn
    exact ne_of_gt (hpos n hn)
  have h2 : Real.log (∏ n ∈ A, (1 + x ^ n)) ≤ Real.log ((1 - x)⁻¹) :=
    Real.log_le_log hprodpos (erdos_350_prod_le A hdis hx0.le hx1)
  rw [Real.log_inv, h1] at h2
  exact h2

statement: erdos_350_int_f (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)

private lemma erdos_350_int_f (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) volume :=
    integrableOn_const erdos_350_volume_ne_top
  refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hconst (erdos_350_meas_f n).restrict ?_
  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with x hx
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
  have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2
  have hpn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ n := pow_nonneg hx0.le n
  have hlog0 : 0 ≤ Real.log (1 + x ^ n) := Real.log_nonneg (by linarith)
  have hxn : x ^ n ≤ x := by
    calc x ^ n ≤ x ^ 1 := pow_le_pow_of_le_one hx0.le hx1.le hn
      _ = x := pow_one x
  have hle : Real.log (1 + x ^ n) ≤ x := le_trans (erdos_350_log_one_add_le hpn) hxn
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hlog0 hx0.le), div_le_one hx0]
  exact hle

name: erdos_350_int_neg_log
statement: erdos_350_int_neg_log : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (1 - x)) (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1)
code:
private lemma erdos_350_int_neg_log :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (1 - x)) (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  have hc : Continuous fun x : ℝ => (1 - x) * Real.log (1 - x) := by
    have h : Continuous fun x : ℝ => 1 - x := by continuity
    exact Real.continuous_mul_log.comp h
  refine intervalIntegral.integrableOn_deriv_of_nonneg
    (g := fun x : ℝ => (1 - x) * Real.log (1 - x) + x) ((hc.add continuous_id).continuousOn)
    ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
    have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2
    have hne : (1 : ℝ) - x ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      linarith [sub_eq_zero.mp h]
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => 1 - y) (-1) x := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).const_sub 1
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.log (1 - y)) ((1 - x)⁻¹ * (-1)) x :=
      (Real.hasDerivAt_log hne).comp x h1
    have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (1 - y) * Real.log (1 - y))
        ((-1) * Real.log (1 - x) + (1 - x) * ((1 - x)⁻¹ * (-1))) x := h1.mul h2
    have h4 := h3.add (hasDerivAt_id' (x := x))
    have hcancel : (1 - x) * ((1 - x)⁻¹ * (-1)) = -1 := by
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_mul]
    have h5 : (-1 : ℝ) * Real.log (1 - x) + (1 - x) * ((1 - x)⁻¹ * (-1)) + 1
        = -Real.log (1 - x) := by
      rw [hcancel]; ring
    rw [h5] at h4
    exact h4
  · intro x hx
    exact erdos_350_neg_log_nonneg hx.1.le hx.2

name: erdos_350_int_g
statement: erdos_350_int_g : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (1 - x) / x) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1)
code:
private lemma erdos_350_int_g :
    IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (1 - x) / x) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
  have hA : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (1 - x) / x)
      (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) := by
    have hconst : IntegrableOn (fun _ : ℝ => (2 : ℝ)) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2)) volume :=
      integrableOn_const erdos_350_volume_ne_top
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hconst erdos_350_meas_g.restrict ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioo] with x hx
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
    have hx1 : x < 1 / 2 := hx.2
    have hnn : 0 ≤ -Real.log (1 - x) := erdos_350_neg_log_nonneg hx0.le (by linarith)
    have hkey : -Real.log (1 - x) ≤ 2 * x := by
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) / (1 + 2 * x) ≤ 1 - x := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by linarith)]
        nlinarith
      have h2 : Real.log (1 / (1 + 2 * x)) ≤ Real.log (1 - x) :=
        Real.log_le_log (by positivity) h1
      rw [Real.log_div one_ne_zero (by positivity), Real.log_one, zero_sub] at h2
      have h3 : Real.log (1 + 2 * x) ≤ 2 * x :=
        erdos_350_log_one_add_le (by linarith)
      linarith
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hnn hx0.le), div_le_iff₀ hx0]
    nlinarith
  have hB : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => -Real.log (1 - x) / x)
      (Set.Ico (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1) := by
    have hsub : Set.Ico (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      intro x hx
      exact ⟨by linarith [hx.1], le_of_lt hx.2⟩
    have hbase : IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => 2 * -Real.log (1 - x))
        (Set.Ico (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1) volume :=
      (erdos_350_int_neg_log.mono_set hsub).const_mul 2
    refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.mono' hbase erdos_350_meas_g.restrict ?_
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ico] with x hx
    have hx0 : (1 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ x := hx.1
    have hx0' : (0 : ℝ) < x := by linarith
    have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2
    have hnn : 0 ≤ -Real.log (1 - x) := erdos_350_neg_log_nonneg (by linarith) hx1
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg hnn hx0'.le), div_le_iff₀ hx0']
    nlinarith
  have hsub : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) (1 / 2) ∪ Set.Ico (1 / 2 : ℝ) 1 := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases h : x < 1 / 2
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hx.1, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨not_lt.mp h, hx.2⟩
  exact (hA.union hB).mono_set hsub

name: erdos_350_image
statement: erdos_350_image (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) '' Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1
code:
private lemma erdos_350_image (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) '' Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 = Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
  have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by
    have : 0 < n := hn
    exact_mod_cast this
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro y ⟨x, ⟨hx0, hx1⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨pow_pos hx0 n, pow_lt_one₀ hx0.le hx1 (by omega)⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨hy0, hy1⟩ := hy
    refine ⟨y ^ ((n : ℝ)⁻¹), ⟨Real.rpow_pos_of_pos hy0 _, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact Real.rpow_lt_one hy0.le hy1 (inv_pos.mpr hnR)
    · exact Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hy0.le (by omega)

name: erdos_350_scale
statement: erdos_350_scale (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (g : ℝ → ℝ) : (∫ u in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, g u) = ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (n : ℝ) * x ^ (n - 1) * g (x ^ n)
code:
private lemma erdos_350_scale (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (g : ℝ → ℝ) :
    (∫ u in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, g u)
      = ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (n : ℝ) * x ^ (n - 1) * g (x ^ n) := by
  have hderiv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      HasDerivWithinAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) ((n : ℝ) * x ^ (n - 1))
        (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) x :=
    fun x _ => (hasDerivAt_pow n x).hasDerivWithinAt
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun x : ℝ => x ^ n) (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    (pow_left_strictMonoOn₀ (M₀ := ℝ) (by omega : n ≠ 0)).injOn.mono
      (fun x hx => le_of_lt hx.1)
  have h := MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul
    measurableSet_Ioo hderiv hinj g
  rw [erdos_350_image n hn] at h
  refine h.trans ?_
  refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo (fun x hx => ?_)
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg hx0.le _)), smul_eq_mul]

name: erdos_350_int_fn
statement: erdos_350_int_fn (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x) = (n : ℝ) * ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x
code:
private lemma erdos_350_int_fn (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x)
      = (n : ℝ) * ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x := by
  have h := erdos_350_scale n hn (fun u => Real.log (1 + u) / u)
  refine h.trans ?_
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      (n : ℝ) * x ^ (n - 1) * (Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x ^ n)
        = (n : ℝ) * (Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
    have hp : (0 : ℝ) < x ^ (n - 1) := pow_pos hx0 _
    have hxn : x ^ n = x ^ (n - 1) * x := by
      rw [← pow_succ]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [hxn]
    field_simp
  rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo hpt,
    MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]

name: erdos_350_I_eq
statement: erdos_350_I_eq : (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x) = 2 * ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x
code:
private lemma erdos_350_I_eq :
    (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x)
      = 2 * ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x := by
  have hpt : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ((2 : ℕ) : ℝ) * x ^ (2 - 1) * (-Real.log (1 - x ^ 2) / x ^ 2)
        = 2 * (-Real.log (1 - x) / x) - 2 * (Real.log (1 + x) / x) := by
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
    have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2
    have hfac : (1 : ℝ) - x ^ 2 = (1 - x) * (1 + x) := by ring
    have h21 : (2 : ℕ) - 1 = 1 := by norm_num
    rw [h21, pow_one, hfac, Real.log_mul (by linarith) (by linarith)]
    have hne : x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hx0
    push_cast
    field_simp
    ring
  have key : (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x)
      = 2 * (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x)
        - 2 * ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x := by
    have h := erdos_350_scale 2 (by norm_num) (fun u => -Real.log (1 - u) / u)
    refine h.trans ?_
    rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioo hpt,
      MeasureTheory.integral_sub (erdos_350_int_g.const_mul 2)
        (erdos_350_int_f1.const_mul 2),
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
  linarith

name: erdos_350_C_ge_one
statement: erdos_350_C_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x
code:
private lemma erdos_350_C_ge_one :
    (1 : ℝ) ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x := by
  have h1 : (∫ _x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, (1 : ℝ))
      ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x := by
    refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on
      (integrableOn_const erdos_350_volume_ne_top) erdos_350_int_g measurableSet_Ioo ?_
    intro x hx
    have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
    have hx1 : x < 1 := hx.2
    rw [le_div_iff₀ hx0, one_mul]
    exact erdos_350_x_le_neg_log hx1
  simpa [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_const, Real.volume_Ioo] using h1

name: erdos_350_int_mono
statement: erdos_350_int_mono (A : Finset ℕ) (h0 : (0 : ℕ) ∉ A) (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, ∑ n ∈ A, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) ≤ -Real.log (1 - x)) : (∑ n ∈ A, ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x) ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x
code:
private lemma erdos_350_int_mono (A : Finset ℕ) (h0 : (0 : ℕ) ∉ A)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∑ n ∈ A, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) ≤ -Real.log (1 - x)) :
    (∑ n ∈ A, ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x)
      ≤ ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, -Real.log (1 - x) / x := by
  have hint : ∀ n ∈ A, IntegrableOn (fun x : ℝ => Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x)
      (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
    intro n hn
    refine erdos_350_int_f n ?_
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hp
    · exact absurd hn h0
    · exact hp
  have hswap := MeasureTheory.integral_finsetSum
    (μ := volume.restrict (Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1))
    (f := fun (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x) A hint
  rw [← hswap]
  refine MeasureTheory.setIntegral_mono_on
    (MeasureTheory.integrable_finsetSum
      (f := fun (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x) A hint)
    erdos_350_int_g measurableSet_Ioo ?_
  intro x hx
  have hx0 : (0 : ℝ) < x := hx.1
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hb x hx) (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hx0))
  simpa [Finset.sum_mul, div_eq_mul_inv] using h

name: erdos_350_le
statement: erdos_350_le (A : Finset ℕ) (hdis : ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ A, ∑ n ∈ S, n = ∑ n ∈ T, n → S = T) : ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ≤ 2
code:
private lemma erdos_350_le (A : Finset ℕ)
    (hdis : ∀ S ⊆ A, ∀ T ⊆ A, ∑ n ∈ S, n = ∑ n ∈ T, n → S = T) :
    ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) ≤ 2 := by
  have h0 := erdos_350_zero_not_mem A hdis
  have hCI := erdos_350_I_eq
  have hC1 := erdos_350_C_ge_one
  have hmono := erdos_350_int_mono A h0
    (fun x hx => erdos_350_log_le A hdis hx.1 hx.2)
  have hterm : ∀ n ∈ A, (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x ^ n) / x)
      = (∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x) * (1 / (n : ℝ)) := by
    intro n hn
    have hn1 : 1 ≤ n := by
      rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hp
      · exact absurd hn h0
      · exact hp
    have hnR : (0 : ℝ) < (n : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hn1
    have h := erdos_350_int_fn n hn1
    rw [mul_one_div, h]
    field_simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hterm, ← Finset.mul_sum] at hmono
  have hIpos : (0 : ℝ) < ∫ x in Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, Real.log (1 + x) / x := by
    linarith
  by_contra hcon
  have hcon' : (2 : ℝ) < ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / (n : ℝ) := not_le.mp hcon
  nlinarith [hmono, hIpos, hCI, hcon']

name: erdos_16_cast_zero
statement: erdos_16_cast_zero {q d : ℕ} (h : q ∣ d) : ((d : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0
code:
private lemma erdos_16_cast_zero {q d : ℕ} (h : q ∣ d) : ((d : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := h
  push_cast
  simp

name: erdos_16_bcast
statement: erdos_16_bcast (a d j m : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdm : ((d : ℕ) : ZMod m) = 0) : ((a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ j : ℕ) : ZMod m) = (a : ZMod m) - 2 ^ j
code:
private lemma erdos_16_bcast (a d j m : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (hdm : ((d : ℕ) : ZMod m) = 0) :
    ((a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ j : ℕ) : ZMod m) = (a : ZMod m) - 2 ^ j := by
  push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hd, hdm]
  ring

/-- Dirichlet case: if `a - 2 ^ k` is a unit mod `d`, the progression contains `2 ^ k + p`. -/

name: erdos_16_unit
statement: erdos_16_unit (a d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (k : ℕ) (hu : IsUnit ((a : ZMod d) - 2 ^ k)) (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ ∃ (k p : ℕ), p.Prime ∧ a + m * d = 2 ^ k + p) : False
code:
private lemma erdos_16_unit (a d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (k : ℕ)
    (hu : IsUnit ((a : ZMod d) - 2 ^ k))
    (hA : ∀ m : ℕ, ¬ ∃ (k p : ℕ), p.Prime ∧ a + m * d = 2 ^ k + p) : False := by
  haveI : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hpgt, hp, hpeq⟩ := Nat.forall_exists_prime_gt_and_eq_mod hu (a + 2 ^ k)
  have h0 : 0 < 2 ^ k := pow_pos (by norm_num) k
  have hcast : ((2 ^ k + p : ℕ) : ZMod d) = ((a : ℕ) : ZMod d) := by
    push_cast
    rw [hpeq]
    ring
  have hmod : (2 ^ k + p) ≡ a [MOD d] := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp hcast
  have hle : a ≤ 2 ^ k + p := by omega
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' hle).mp hmod.symm
  refine hA t ⟨k, p, hp, ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.mul_comm t d]
  omega

/-- From the failure of the unit condition we read off, for each `k`, an odd prime `q ∣ d`
with `a ≡ 2 ^ (k+1)` mod `q`. -/

name: erdos_16_cover
statement: erdos_16_cover (a d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hodda : Odd a) (hnu : ∀ k : ℕ, ¬ IsUnit ((a : ZMod d) - 2 ^ k)) (k : ℕ) : ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ d ∧ (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1) ∧ q ≠ 2
code:
private lemma erdos_16_cover (a d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hodda : Odd a)
    (hnu : ∀ k : ℕ, ¬ IsUnit ((a : ZMod d) - 2 ^ k)) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ d ∧ (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1) ∧ q ≠ 2 := by
  haveI : NeZero d := ⟨hd.ne'⟩
  have hbcast : ((a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod d) = (a : ZMod d) - 2 ^ (k + 1) :=
    erdos_16_bcast a d (k + 1) d hd (ZMod.natCast_self d)
  have hnc : ¬ Nat.Coprime (a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1)) d := by
    rw [← ZMod.isUnit_iff_coprime, hbcast]
    exact hnu (k + 1)
  have hg : Nat.gcd (a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1)) d ≠ 1 := hnc
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqg⟩ := Nat.exists_prime_and_dvd hg
  have hqb : q ∣ a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1) := hqg.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_left _ _)
  have hqd : q ∣ d := hqg.trans (Nat.gcd_dvd_right _ _)
  have hbq : ((a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod q) = (a : ZMod q) - 2 ^ (k + 1) :=
    erdos_16_bcast a d (k + 1) q hd (erdos_16_cast_zero hqd)
  have hzero : ((a + (d - 1) * 2 ^ (k + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := erdos_16_cast_zero hqb
  rw [hbq, sub_eq_zero] at hzero
  refine ⟨q, hq, hqd, hzero, ?_⟩
  rintro rfl
  have hae : ((a : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = 0 := by
    rw [hzero]
    have : ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = 0 := erdos_16_cast_zero dvd_rfl
    push_cast at this
    rw [pow_succ, this, mul_zero]
  have : (2 : ℕ) ∣ a := by
    have h1 : ((a : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = ((0 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) := by simpa using hae
    exact (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).mp ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp h1)
  rw [Nat.odd_iff] at hodda
  omega

/-- The value of a member of the new class modulo a covering prime. -/

name: erdos_16_nval
statement: erdos_16_nval (d' inv2 a n q k : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) (hqd' : q ∣ d') (h2inv : 2 * inv2 = d' + 1) (hmod : n ≡ a * inv2 [MOD d']) (hqa : (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1)) : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 2 ^ k
code:
private lemma erdos_16_nval (d' inv2 a n q k : ℕ) (hq : q.Prime) (hqd' : q ∣ d')
    (h2inv : 2 * inv2 = d' + 1) (hmod : n ≡ a * inv2 [MOD d'])
    (hqa : (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1)) : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 2 ^ k := by
  have hnq : n ≡ a * inv2 [MOD q] := hmod.of_dvd hqd'
  have h1 : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((a * inv2 : ℕ) : ZMod q) :=
    (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mpr hnq
  have hd'0 : ((d' : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := erdos_16_cast_zero hqd'
  have hinv : (2 : ZMod q) * ((inv2 : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 1 := by
    have h3 : ((2 * inv2 : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((d' + 1 : ℕ) : ZMod q) := by rw [h2inv]
    push_cast at h3
    rw [hd'0, zero_add] at h3
    exact h3
  rw [h1]
  push_cast
  rw [hqa, pow_succ]
  calc (2 : ZMod q) ^ k * 2 * ((inv2 : ℕ) : ZMod q)
      = 2 ^ k * (2 * ((inv2 : ℕ) : ZMod q)) := by ring
    _ = 2 ^ k := by rw [hinv, mul_one]

/-- Every member of the new residue class is odd, non-representable, and outside the AP. -/

name: erdos_16_mem
statement: erdos_16_mem (a d d' inv2 s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hodda : Odd a) (hdeq : d = 2 ^ s * d') (hodd' : Odd d') (hcov : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ d ∧ (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1) ∧ q ≠ 2) (h2inv : 2 * inv2 = d' + 1) (n : ℕ) (hn1 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ d]) (hnd' : n ≡ a * inv2 [MOD d']) (hbig : d + 2 ^ d < n) : (Odd n ∧ ¬ ∃ (k p : ℕ), p.Prime ∧ n = 2 ^ k + p) ∧ n ∉ Set.range (fun m : ℕ => a + m * d)
code:
private lemma erdos_16_mem (a d d' inv2 s : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hodda : Odd a)
    (hdeq : d = 2 ^ s * d') (hodd' : Odd d')
    (hcov : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ q : ℕ, q.Prime ∧ q ∣ d ∧ (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1) ∧ q ≠ 2)
    (h2inv : 2 * inv2 = d' + 1)
    (n : ℕ) (hn1 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ d]) (hnd' : n ≡ a * inv2 [MOD d'])
    (hbig : d + 2 ^ d < n) :
    (Odd n ∧ ¬ ∃ (k p : ℕ), p.Prime ∧ n = 2 ^ k + p) ∧
      n ∉ Set.range (fun m : ℕ => a + m * d) := by
  have hdlt : d < 2 ^ d := Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  have hqdvd' : ∀ q : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ d → q ≠ 2 → q ∣ d' := by
    intro q hq hqd hq2
    rw [hdeq] at hqd
    have hcop : Nat.Coprime q (2 ^ s) := by
      refine Nat.Coprime.pow_right _ ((Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd hq).mpr ?_)
      intro hcon
      exact hq2 ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq Nat.prime_two).mp hcon)
    exact hcop.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hqd
  have hval : ∀ q k : ℕ, q.Prime → q ∣ d → q ≠ 2 → (a : ZMod q) = 2 ^ (k + 1) →
      ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 2 ^ k := by
    intro q k hq hqd hq2 hqa
    exact erdos_16_nval d' inv2 a n q k hq (hqdvd' q hq hqd hq2) h2inv hnd' hqa
  constructor
  · constructor
    · have h2 : n ≡ 1 [MOD 2] := hn1.of_dvd (dvd_pow_self 2 (by omega : d ≠ 0))
      rw [Nat.odd_iff]
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using h2
    · rintro ⟨k, p, hp, hnkp⟩
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd, hqa, hq2⟩ := hcov k
      have hnq : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 2 ^ k := hval q k hq hqd hq2 hqa
      have hp0 : ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 0 := by
        have hc : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 2 ^ k + ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q) := by
          rw [hnkp]; push_cast; ring
        rw [hnq] at hc
        linear_combination -hc
      have hqp : q ∣ p := by
        have h1 : ((p : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((0 : ℕ) : ZMod q) := by simpa using hp0
        exact (Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).mp ((ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp h1)
      have hpq : q = p := (Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq hq hp).mp hqp
      have hqled : q ≤ d := Nat.le_of_dvd hd hqd
      have hpled : p ≤ d := by omega
      by_cases hk : d ≤ k
      · have hdvd : (2 : ℕ) ^ d ∣ 2 ^ k := pow_dvd_pow 2 hk
        have h1 : (2 : ℕ) ^ k + p ≡ 0 + p [MOD 2 ^ d] :=
          Nat.ModEq.add_right p ((Nat.modEq_zero_iff_dvd).mpr hdvd)
        have h2 : n ≡ p [MOD 2 ^ d] := by
          rw [hnkp]; simpa using h1
        have h3 : p ≡ 1 [MOD 2 ^ d] := h2.symm.trans hn1
        have h4 : p % 2 ^ d = 1 % 2 ^ d := h3
        rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at h4
        have := hp.two_le
        omega
      · push_neg at hk
        have h5 : (2 : ℕ) ^ k ≤ 2 ^ d := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by norm_num) hk.le
        omega
  · rintro ⟨j, hj⟩
    obtain ⟨q, hq, hqd, hqa, hq2⟩ := hcov 0
    have hnq : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = 2 ^ 0 := hval q 0 hq hqd hq2 hqa
    have hna : ((n : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((a : ℕ) : ZMod q) := by
      rw [← hj]
      push_cast
      rw [erdos_16_cast_zero hqd]
      ring
    rw [hna, hqa] at hnq
    have e1 : ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod q) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod q) := by
      push_cast
      simpa using hnq
    have h12 : (2 : ℕ) ≡ 1 [MOD q] := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp e1
    have hq1 : q ∣ 1 := by
      simpa using (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd' (by norm_num : (1 : ℕ) ≤ 2)).mp h12.symm
    exact hq.ne_one (Nat.dvd_one.mp hq1)

name: single_pair_eq
statement: single_pair_eq (a b i j : ℕ) : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) i + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) j = Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b) ↔ (i = a ∧ j = b)
code:
private lemma single_pair_eq (a b i j : ℕ) :
    (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) i + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) j
      = Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b) ↔ (i = a ∧ j = b) := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h0 := congrArg (fun f : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => f 0) h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun f : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ => f 1) h
    simp only [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_apply] at h0 h1
    norm_num at h0 h1
    exact ⟨h0, h1⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: coeff_two_var
statement: coeff_two_var {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b i j : ℕ) (c : R) : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b) ((X 0 ^ i * X 1 ^ j : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) * MvPolynomial.C c) = if (i = a ∧ j = b) then c else 0
code:
private lemma coeff_two_var {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b i j : ℕ) (c : R) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b)
      ((X 0 ^ i * X 1 ^ j : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) * MvPolynomial.C c)
      = if (i = a ∧ j = b) then c else 0 := by
  have h : ((X 0 ^ i * X 1 ^ j : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) * MvPolynomial.C c)
      = monomial (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) i + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) j) c := by
    rw [X_pow_eq_monomial, X_pow_eq_monomial, monomial_mul, C_apply, monomial_mul]
    simp
  rw [h, coeff_monomial]
  simp only [single_pair_eq]

name: coeff_add_pow_two
statement: coeff_add_pow_two {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b = n) : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b) ((X 0 + X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) ^ n) = (n.choose a : R)
code:
private lemma coeff_add_pow_two {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b = n) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b)
      ((X 0 + X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) ^ n) = (n.choose a : R) := by
  rw [add_pow, coeff_sum]
  have key : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b)
        ((X 0 ^ i * X 1 ^ (n - i) : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
          * (n.choose i : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R))
      = if i = a then (n.choose a : R) else 0 := by
    intro i _
    rw [show ((n.choose i : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R))
        = MvPolynomial.C ((n.choose i : ℕ) : R) from (map_natCast MvPolynomial.C _).symm,
      coeff_two_var]
    by_cases h : i = a
    · subst h
      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, by omega⟩, if_pos rfl]
    · rw [if_neg (by tauto), if_neg h]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl key, Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range (n + 1)) a
    (fun _ => (n.choose a : R)), if_pos (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))]

name: coeff_key
statement: coeff_key {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b + 2 = n + 1) : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1)) (((X 0 - X 1) * (X 0 + X 1) ^ n : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)) = (n.choose a : R) - (n.choose (a + 1) : R)
code:
private lemma coeff_key {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (n a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b + 2 = n + 1) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      (((X 0 - X 1) * (X 0 + X 1) ^ n : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R))
      = (n.choose a : R) - (n.choose (a + 1) : R) := by
  have hs0 : Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1)
      = Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 := by
    rw [← Finsupp.single_add]
  have hs1 : Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1)
      = Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) 1 := by
    rw [← Finsupp.single_add]
  have e0 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      = (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) a + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
        + Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) 1 := by
    rw [hs0]; abel
  have e1 : (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      = (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) b)
        + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) 1 := by
    rw [hs1]; abel
  have hsplit : ((X 0 - X 1) * (X 0 + X 1) ^ n : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)
      = ((X 0 + X 1) ^ n) * X 0 - ((X 0 + X 1) ^ n) * X 1 := by ring
  rw [hsplit, coeff_sub]
  have h0 : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      (((X 0 + X 1) ^ n : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) * X 0) = (n.choose a : R) := by
    rw [e0, coeff_mul_X, coeff_add_pow_two n a (b + 1) (by omega)]
  have h1 : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      (((X 0 + X 1) ^ n : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) * X 1) = (n.choose (a + 1) : R) := by
    rw [e1, coeff_mul_X, coeff_add_pow_two n (a + 1) b (by omega)]
  rw [h0, h1]

statement: totalDegree_pow_XaddX {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (m : ℕ) : ((X 0 + X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) ^ m).totalDegree ≤ m

private lemma totalDegree_pow_XaddX {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (m : ℕ) :

name: prod_struct
statement: prod_struct {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (C0 : Finset R) : ∃ r : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R, (∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c)) = (X 0 + X 1) ^ C0.card + r ∧ (r.totalDegree + 1 ≤ C0.card ∨ r = 0)
code:
private lemma prod_struct {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (C0 : Finset R) :
    ∃ r : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R,
      (∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c)) = (X 0 + X 1) ^ C0.card + r ∧
        (r.totalDegree + 1 ≤ C0.card ∨ r = 0) := by
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on C0 ⟨0, by simp, Or.inr rfl⟩ ?_
  intro c s hcs ih
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hdeg⟩ := ih
  refine ⟨-(MvPolynomial.C c * (X 0 + X 1) ^ s.card)
      + (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c) * r, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.prod_insert hcs, hr, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hcs]
    ring
  · left
    rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hcs]
    have h1 : (-(MvPolynomial.C c * (X 0 + X 1) ^ s.card)
        : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R).totalDegree ≤ s.card := by
      rw [totalDegree_neg]
      refine le_trans (totalDegree_mul _ _) ?_
      rw [totalDegree_C]
      simpa using totalDegree_pow_XaddX (R := R) s.card
    have hsc : ((X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R)).totalDegree ≤ 1 := by
      refine le_trans (totalDegree_sub _ _) ?_
      rw [totalDegree_C]
      simpa using totalDegree_XaddX (R := R)
    have h2 : ((X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c) * r : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R).totalDegree
        ≤ s.card := by
      rcases hdeg with h | h
      · have := totalDegree_mul (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) r
        omega
      · rw [h, mul_zero, totalDegree_zero]
        exact Nat.zero_le _
    have h3 := totalDegree_add (-(MvPolynomial.C c * (X 0 + X 1) ^ s.card)
      : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) ((X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c) * r)
    omega

name: coeff_f
statement: coeff_f {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (C0 : Finset R) (a b : ℕ) (hab : a + b + 2 = C0.card + 1) : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1)) ((X 0 - X 1) * ∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c)) = (C0.card.choose a : R) - (C0.card.choose (a + 1) : R)
code:
private lemma coeff_f {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (C0 : Finset R) (a b : ℕ)
    (hab : a + b + 2 = C0.card + 1) :
    coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      ((X 0 - X 1) * ∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c))
      = (C0.card.choose a : R) - (C0.card.choose (a + 1) : R) := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hdeg⟩ := prod_struct C0
  rw [hr, mul_add, coeff_add, coeff_key C0.card a b hab]
  have hz : coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (a + 1) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (b + 1))
      ((X 0 - X 1) * r : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) = 0 := by
    apply coeff_eq_zero_of_totalDegree_lt
    rw [← Finsupp.degree_apply, degree_pair]
    have hd := totalDegree_mul (X 0 - X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) R) r
    have hd2 := totalDegree_XsubX (R := R)
    rcases hdeg with h | h
    · omega
    · rw [h, mul_zero, totalDegree_zero]
      omega
  rw [hz, add_zero]

name: choose_identity
statement: choose_identity (m : ℕ) : (m + 1) * ((2 * m).choose (m + 1)) = m * ((2 * m).choose m)
code:
private lemma choose_identity (m : ℕ) :
    (m + 1) * ((2 * m).choose (m + 1)) = m * ((2 * m).choose m) := by
  have key := Nat.add_one_mul_choose_eq (2 * m) m
  rw [Nat.choose_succ_succ] at key
  simp only [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] at key
  have keyz : (2 * (m : ℤ) + 1) * (((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = ((((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ℤ) + (((2 * m).choose (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)) * ((m : ℤ) + 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast key
  have : ((m : ℤ) + 1) * (((2 * m).choose (m + 1) : ℕ) : ℤ)
      = (m : ℤ) * (((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ℤ) := by linear_combination -keyz
  exact_mod_cast this

name: central_ne_zero
statement: central_ne_zero (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 * m < p) : ((((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ZMod p)) ≠ 0
code:
private lemma central_ne_zero (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 * m < p) :
    ((((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ZMod p)) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff] at h
  have hfac : ((2 * m).choose m) * Nat.factorial m * Nat.factorial (2 * m - m)
      = Nat.factorial (2 * m) :=
    Nat.choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial (by omega)
  have hdvd : p ∣ Nat.factorial (2 * m) := by
    rw [← hfac]
    exact Dvd.dvd.mul_right (Dvd.dvd.mul_right h _) _
  have := (Nat.Prime.dvd_factorial hp).mp hdvd
  omega

name: choose_diff_ne_zero
statement: choose_diff_ne_zero (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 * m < p) : ((((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ZMod p) - (((2 * m).choose (m + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod p)) ≠ 0
code:
private lemma choose_diff_ne_zero (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (m : ℕ) (hm : 2 * m < p) :
    ((((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ZMod p) - (((2 * m).choose (m + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod p)) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  have hcc : (((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ZMod p) = (((2 * m).choose (m + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod p) :=
    eq_of_sub_eq_zero hzero
  have h1z : ((m : ZMod p) + 1) * (((2 * m).choose (m + 1) : ℕ) : ZMod p)
      = (m : ZMod p) * (((2 * m).choose m : ℕ) : ZMod p) := by
    have := congrArg (fun x : ℕ => (x : ZMod p)) (choose_identity m)
    push_cast at this
    linear_combination this
  exact central_ne_zero p hp m hm (by linear_combination h1z + ((m : ZMod p) + 1) * hcc)

private def sumset {p : ℕ} (A : Finset (ZMod p)) : Finset (ZMod p) :=
  ((A ×ˢ A).filter (fun q : ZMod p × ZMod p => q.1 ≠ q.2)).image
    (fun q : ZMod p × ZMod p => q.1 + q.2)

name: mem_sumset
statement: mem_sumset {p : ℕ} {A : Finset (ZMod p)} {x y : ZMod p} (hx : x ∈ A) (hy : y ∈ A) (hxy : x ≠ y) : x + y ∈ sumset A
code:
private lemma mem_sumset {p : ℕ} {A : Finset (ZMod p)} {x y : ZMod p}
    (hx : x ∈ A) (hy : y ∈ A) (hxy : x ≠ y) : x + y ∈ sumset A := by
  refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨(x, y), ?_, rfl⟩
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
  exact ⟨⟨hx, hy⟩, hxy⟩

name: erdos_476_core
statement: erdos_476_core (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (k : ℕ) (A : Finset (ZMod p)) (hk : A.card = k + 3) (hkp : 2 * k + 2 < p) : 2 * k + 3 ≤ (sumset A).card
code:
private lemma erdos_476_core (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) (k : ℕ) (A : Finset (ZMod p))
    (hk : A.card = k + 3) (hkp : 2 * k + 2 < p) :
    2 * k + 3 ≤ (sumset A).card := by
  haveI : Fact (Nat.Prime p) := ⟨hp⟩
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.pos.ne'⟩
  by_contra hcon
  obtain ⟨C0, hDC, hC0card⟩ := Finset.exists_superset_card_eq
    (s := sumset A) (n := 2 * k + 2) (by omega) (by rw [ZMod.card]; omega)
  set f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (ZMod p) :=
    (X 0 - X 1) * ∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c) with hf
  set t : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ :=
    Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) (k + 2) + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (k + 1) with ht
  have hcoeff : coeff t f ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ht, hf, coeff_f C0 (k + 1) k (by omega), hC0card,
      show 2 * k + 2 = 2 * (k + 1) by ring]
    exact choose_diff_ne_zero p hp (k + 1) (by omega)
  have htdeg : t.degree = 2 * k + 3 := by rw [ht, degree_pair]; ring
  have htot : f.totalDegree = t.degree := by
    refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
    · have hprod : (∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c)
          : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (ZMod p)).totalDegree ≤ C0.card := by
        refine le_trans (totalDegree_finsetProd _ _) ?_
        refine le_trans (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun c _ => totalDegree_lin c)) ?_
        simp
      have h2 := totalDegree_XsubX (R := ZMod p)
      have h3 : f.totalDegree ≤ (X 0 - X 1 : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (ZMod p)).totalDegree
          + (∏ c ∈ C0, (X 0 + X 1 - MvPolynomial.C c)
              : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) (ZMod p)).totalDegree := by
        rw [hf]; exact totalDegree_mul _ _
      omega
    · have hmem : t ∈ f.support := mem_support_iff.mpr hcoeff
      have hle := MvPolynomial.le_totalDegree hmem
      simpa [Finsupp.degree_apply, Finsupp.sum] using hle
  have hSt : ∀ i : Fin 2, t i < A.card := by
    intro i
    rw [hk, ht]
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  obtain ⟨sv, hsv, hne⟩ := MvPolynomial.combinatorial_nullstellensatz_exists_eval_nonzero
    f t hcoeff htot (fun _ => A) hSt
  have heval : eval sv f = (sv 0 - sv 1) * ∏ c ∈ C0, (sv 0 + sv 1 - c) := by
    rw [hf]
    simp
  rw [heval] at hne
  have hd : sv 0 ≠ sv 1 := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    rw [h, sub_self, zero_mul]
  have hmemC : sv 0 + sv 1 ∈ C0 := hDC (mem_sumset (hsv 0) (hsv 1) hd)
  exact hne (by rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero hmemC (sub_self _), mul_zero])
